scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 请检查您的物品栏。您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
....a guy....?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
...一个家伙...？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ah! Hey! Man!
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
啊！嘿！伙计！

scripts.text: What's up?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Have you ever heard of horrific human experimentation committed in Rekenber Corporation whose head office is here in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你听说过雷肯贝尔公司总部在里希塔乐镇，却在那里进行可怕的人体实验的事情吗？

scripts.text: Whaaat?! human experimentation?
scripts.translation: 什么？！人体实验？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Yea! human experimentation!!
There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
没错！就是人体实验！！
有很多传言说那里确实在进行可怕的人体实验，但贫民窟里的人...因为雷肯贝尔的福利活动，不太愿意相信这些。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Well! and those rich people, seem to know something but they never mention that...
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
嗯！而那些富人，似乎知道些什么，但他们从不提起...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ahh!! And this is a secret that just SOME PEOPLE know. I heard that from Rekenber Lab.,.. a person named...um...Wol....
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
啊！！而且这是一个只有少数人知道的秘密。我听说从雷肯贝尔实验室...一个名叫...嗯...沃...的人...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Anyway!! A scientist named Wolf.. something suddenly got sacked. and he must be related with this rumor, I think...
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
总之！！一位名叫沃尔夫...什么的科学家突然被解雇了。我觉得他肯定和这个传言有关...

scripts.text: You mean... Wolfchev?
scripts.translation: 你是说...沃尔夫切夫？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ohhhh?! yeah Wolfchev!! That's right, the name was Wolfchev.. The mad scientist..
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
哦哦哦？！没错，就是沃尔夫切夫！！对，名字是沃尔夫切夫...那个疯狂科学家...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I suppose you can then understand the story faster... I am sure that he's involved in the rumor. I swear.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我想你现在应该能更快理解这个故事了...我确信他卷入了这个传言。我发誓。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
By the way..what about you? Is there anything that you know about him?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
顺便问一下...你呢？你知道关于他的什么吗？

scripts.text: Pretend you know nothing.
scripts.translation: 假装你什么都不知道。

scripts.text: Tell him what you know.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你知道的事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not really. I've ever heard of his name, but I don't know anything about him..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么。我只听说过他的名字，但对他一无所知...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Hm.... You sound suspicious, dude! huh?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
嗯...你听起来很可疑啊，伙计！嗯？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He happens to research into Human 'Homunculus' without telling that to Rekenber Corp., and there was a whistle-blower who reported to the corp. so he was fired.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他私下研究人类的“生命体”，没有告诉雷肯贝尔公司，结果有举报者向公司报告，所以他被解雇了。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Oh! Man..! You seem to know pretty much! By any chance, are you concerned with Rekenber??
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
哦！伙计！你似乎知道得很多！顺便问一下，你和雷肯贝尔有关系吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Don't worry. I didn't mean anything.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
别担心。我没有别的意思。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Well! I am just curious only because some people in the slum and some adventurers were missing,
and I heard that Rekenber was doing human experimentation with those missing people. Hope you don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
嗯！我只是好奇，因为贫民窟里的一些人和一些冒险者失踪了，
而且我听说雷肯贝尔正在用那些失踪者进行人体实验。希望你不要误会我的意思。

scripts.text:
Actually, it is not a funny rumor.
Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.
scripts.translation:
实际上，这可不是什么有趣的谣言。
应该去调查一下进行实验的实验室。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Oh! What a beautiful lady!!
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
哦！多么美丽的女士！！

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
How come a beauty is here, in a place with dangerous rumor?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
为什么一位美人会出现在这个充满危险谣言的地方？

scripts.text: Walking...
scripts.translation: 散步...

scripts.text: To hang out...
scripts.translation: 闲逛...

scripts.text: Shopping...
scripts.translation: 购物...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ahh.. Lady, you are so graceful even when you are just walking.....
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
啊...女士，您只是散步都如此优雅.....

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Lady. You are a dignified lady even if you hang out in this poor town...
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
女士。即使您在这个贫穷的城镇闲逛，依然显得如此高贵...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ahh.. Lady.. Shopping in the slum!!.. Are you a type who needs to look around every single shop?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
啊...女士..在贫民窟购物！！..您是那种需要逛遍每一家店铺的类型吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Well, how dare I ask you and be interested in what the lady does...
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
唉，我哪敢问您，还关心女士在做什么...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I just hope that the lady gets out of this town with dangerous rumors..
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我只希望女士能离开这个充满危险谣言的城镇..

scripts.text: Dangerous rumors?
scripts.translation: 危险的谣言？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Ah... Lady may not have heard of the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
啊...女士可能还没听说过这个谣言。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Recently, some people from this town, actually from the slum...and some adventurers are missing...
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
最近，这个城镇的一些人，实际上来自贫民窟...还有一些冒险者失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
and then the rumor came up, since disappearance cases happen pretty often, that Rekenber is committing a horrible human experimentation in their secret lab.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
然后谣言就传开了，因为失踪案件经常发生，说雷肯贝尔在他们的秘密实验室里进行可怕的人体实验。

scripts.text: Excuse me?! human experimentation?
scripts.translation: 恕我直言？！人体实验？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Yea! human experimentation!!
There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
没错！就是人体实验！！
有很多传言说那里确实在进行可怕的人体实验，但贫民窟里的人...因为雷肯贝尔的福利活动，不太愿意相信这些。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Well! the rich people either want to believe..I think.. Ah!! And couple of weeks ago. um. what's his name? Wolfchev??
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
嗯！有钱人要么就是想要相信..我想.. 啊！！还有几周前。嗯。他叫什么名字？沃尔夫切夫？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Anyway!! that research got fired from the lab. I think he must be involved with this rumor.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
总之！！那个研究员被实验室开除了。我觉得他肯定和这个传闻有关。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
So, please, lady. Please don't be in a place like this and stay in safe ways.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
所以，拜托了，女士。请不要待在像这里这样危险的地方，要确保自身安全。

scripts.text:
............ It seems a pretty serious matter.
Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.
scripts.translation:
............ 看来情况相当严重。
应该去调查一下进行实验的那个实验室。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Take care yourself and don't disappear!
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
照顾好自己，别失踪了！

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Be careful, Lady.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
请小心，女士。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Only those beautiful ladies are the reason of my life~!
I, Giacomo Girolamo Casanova de Seingalt am never interested in guys like you though!!
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
只有那些美丽的女士才是我生命的意义~！
我，贾科莫·吉罗拉莫·卡萨诺瓦·德·森加尔，对你们这种家伙可没兴趣！！

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
but I can listen to you...you wanna say anything to me?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
不过我可以听听你的话...你想对我说点什么吗？

scripts.text: No..?
About ladies..
scripts.translation: 关于女士们...

scripts.text: You Womanizer!!
scripts.translation: 你这个花花公子！！

scripts.text: Envy you...
scripts.translation: 真羡慕你...

scripts.text: What's the rumor lately?
scripts.translation: 最近有什么传闻吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Hey you, get out of my way then..
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
喂你，让开好吗...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I don't feel like talking about my precious ladies making fun of them. You do it with your friends.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我不想谈论我珍贵的女士们，更不想听你们取笑她们。这种事你们去找朋友聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Hey.. Excuse me!!! but I'm not a 'Womanizer', I am just a person who adores ladies.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
喂...请原谅我！！！但我不是“花花公子”，我只是个欣赏女士的人。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Of course..... Yea... If I'm a womanizer, all the men on earth are too! I'm just Casanova. umhahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
当然......是的...如果我是花花公子，那世上所有男人都是了！我只是卡萨诺瓦。嗯哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Haa.. Do you....? not have any woman but your sister and mother around you?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
哈啊.. 你....？身边除了姐妹和母亲，就没有别的女士了吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
... .... ...

[Giacomo Girolamo]
Oh...... sorry.. I got your point....
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
哦......抱歉.. 我明白你的意思了....

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
You.. are not like how you seem? Interesting..
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你...看起来不像表面那样呢？有意思..

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Yea, actually recently a lot of people from the slum and some wandering adventurers got disappeared. and I don't know why.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
是的，实际上最近贫民窟的很多人和一些流浪的冒险者都失踪了。我不知道为什么。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
You gotta be careful too..
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你也得小心点...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Hey, lady?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
嘿，女士？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Wasn't it painful when you fell down from Heaven, my Angel?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
从天上掉下来的时候，疼吗，我的天使？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
You must be tired. Because you are always wandering my mind.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你一定很累吧。因为你总是在我的脑海里徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Are you not tired of walking around in my dream last night?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
昨晚在我的梦里走来走去，你不累吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Excuse me. But I think I lost my heart. Could you please borrow me yours?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
抱歉。但我好像弄丢了我的心。能借我你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Do you believe in love at first sight?? Or can we start again..?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你相信一见钟情吗？或者我们可以重新开始...

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I am so sorry but, can you kiss with a person who just met?? Noo? Ok then let me introduce myself.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
很抱歉，但你能和刚认识的人接吻吗？不行？好吧，那让我自我介绍一下。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I'm so lost here since it's the first time. Can you let me know which is the way to your heart?
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我是第一次来这里，迷路了。能告诉我通往你心里的路吗？

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Give me a map please.. To get a way....I'm fallen in your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
请给我一张地图...找到路...我迷失在你的眼眸里。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Your eyes....I wanna be forever there.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
你的眼睛...我想永远留在那里。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
I promise that I will be your everything in any case, in any difficult situation.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我承诺，无论发生什么，无论情况多么艰难，我都会是你的一切。

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Today is the first day we met, but I love you, Lady <3
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
今天是我们见面的第一天，但我已经爱上你了，女士 <3

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
Today is the first day we met, but I love you, Lady <3
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
今天是我们见面的第一天，但我已经爱上你了，女士 <3

scripts.text:
[Giacomo Girolamo]
And I am telling you this because I'm just worried about you. You need to get out of this town which is full of disappearance cases.
scripts.translation:
[贾科莫·吉罗拉莫]
我告诉你这些是因为我很担心你。你需要离开这个充满失踪案的城镇。

scripts.text: In order to investigate human experimentation, I had to go down whilst I didn't want to because of gruesome sound.
scripts.translation: 为了调查人体实验，我不得不下去，尽管因为那可怕的声音，我并不想下去。

scripts.text:
- Whistling sound -
From below, there comes a gruesome sound mingling with the wind.
scripts.translation:
- 口哨声 -
从下方传来可怕的声音，与风声交织在一起。

scripts.text: I arrived at a research facility which seems it has been used till these days.
scripts.translation: 我到达了一个看起来直到今天还在使用的研究设施。

scripts.text: There are some destroyed part, but the basic facility seem fine.
scripts.translation: 有一些损坏的部分，但基本设施看起来完好无损。

scripts.text: Get around a little more...
scripts.translation: 再四处看看...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You!!!! are Wolfchev?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你！！！就是沃尔夫切夫？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
A Human! kaahaha. People tend to hate this place, why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
人类！卡哈哈。人们都讨厌这个地方，你为什么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You!!! I heard that you were committing human experimentation. Wolfchev!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你！！！我听说你在进行人体实验。沃尔夫切夫！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And I see that you are still committing that!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且我看到你还在继续做那些事！！！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Kihihihi. I can see that you know something about me. Is that you who accused me?
How dare you come back to me after you did that. Kihihih
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嘻嘻嘻嘻。看来你对我有所了解。是你指控我的吗？
你做了那样的事，还敢回来找我。嘻嘻嘻嘻

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I feel good to see a human
in a long time, but I gotta go. Kihihihi.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
好久没见到人类了，感觉还不错，但我得走了。嘻嘻嘻嘻。

scripts.text: - Wolfchev ran away giving a awkward laughing sound. -
scripts.translation: - 沃尔夫切夫发出尴尬的笑声，跑开了。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa! Wolfchev, stop!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇！沃尔夫切夫，停下！

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 请检查您的物品栏。您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
(Gasping) Pshaw... you are still following me. Hey, why do you keep following me?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
（喘气）啧...你还在跟着我。嘿，你为什么一直跟着我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wolfchev.. You said before. that you are doing research for everybody.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沃尔夫切夫.. 你之前说过，你的研究是为了大家。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I might have said that.... so what?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我可能说过... 那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, your experiment seem really dangerous. How come this is what everybody wants?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，你的实验看起来很危险。这怎么可能是大家想要的？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Everyone has a desire to be stronger and wants to dominate others so those other people obey and admire you. Do you not have that desire?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
每个人都渴望变得更强，想要支配他人，让其他人服从并崇拜你。难道你没有这种欲望吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
If you want to save yourself, should stop following me. Bugger off.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
如果你想救自己，就别跟着我了。滚开。

scripts.text: Wolfchev is again running away with a strange sound.
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫又发出奇怪的声音，跑开了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Awwww!! You!! running away again..... Stop!
^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 请检查您的物品栏。您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You are pretty persistent, aren't you? Or I think.......that you like me, huh? Kihihii.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你还挺执着的，不是吗？或者我觉得.......你喜欢我，对吧？嘻嘻嘻。

scripts.text: Wolfchev mocked you at your silence and pressed a button in his hand. Then guinea pigs woken up around him.
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫嘲笑你的沉默，按下了手中的按钮。然后他周围的豚鼠醒了过来。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Again.. it's time to say goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
又是... 该说再见的时候了。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Well! May be....
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嗯！也许....

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
If you come to me for the experimentation, I can treat you better.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
如果你是为了实验来找我的，我可以给你更好的待遇。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh my,... What happened?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
天哪... 发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
No! Don't come to me! Don't!!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
不！别过来！别过来！！

scripts.text: First of all, I gotta handle those guinea pigs!
scripts.translation: 首先，我得处理那些豚鼠！

scripts.text: Wolfchev is confused and has no idea now since those monsters are attacking him too.
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫很困惑，因为他发现那些魔物也在攻击他。

scripts.text: - Hit him to wake him up -
scripts.translation: - 打他一下让他清醒过来 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey Dude! Anyway let's get out of here first! Isn't there any place where they cannot reach?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，伙计！不管怎样，我们先离开这里吧！有没有它们到不了的地方？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oooops.. then my....my lab....to my lab...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
糟糕... 我的... 我的实验室... 去我的实验室...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your lab?? Okay, where's that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的实验室？？好的，在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
to the north....... . Not so far from here..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
往北走....... . 离这里不远..

scripts.text: Go to '^0000FFWolfchev's Lab^000000' at the 12 o'clock direction...
scripts.translation: 前往位于12点钟方向的'^0000FF沃尔夫切夫的实验室^000000'...

scripts.text: Wolfchev is confused and has no idea now since those monsters are attacking him too.
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫很困惑，因为他发现那些魔物也在攻击他。

scripts.text: Go to '^0000FFWolfchev's Lab^000000' at the 12 o'clock direction...
scripts.translation: 前往位于12点钟方向的'^0000FF沃尔夫切夫的实验室^000000'...

scripts.text: I arrived at '^0000FFWolfchev's Lab^000000'.
scripts.translation: 我到达了'^0000FF沃尔夫切夫的实验室^000000'。

scripts.text: I still have something to do with Wolfchev.
scripts.translation: 我还有事要和沃尔夫切夫谈。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You cannot continue the process due to possessing too many belongings.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000由于携带物品过多，您无法继续流程。^000000

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
What! Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
什么！你在这里有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Yes I do!!
scripts.translation: 是的，我有事！

scripts.text: Umm.. No..

[Researcher]
Why don't stop staring at other's laboratory, and be on your way?
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
别盯着别人的实验室看了，快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Stop wondering here, and be on your way. Will you? Khh Khh.
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
别在这里徘徊了，快走吧。听到了吗？嘻嘻。

scripts.text: It seems experimental creatures cannot come near the laboratory, just like Wolfchev said.
scripts.translation: 看来实验生物确实无法靠近实验室，正如沃尔夫切夫所说的那样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, is there any way to stop those creatures? You should know something, you made those things!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，有什么办法能阻止那些生物吗？你应该知道些什么，毕竟是你制造了它们！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Urrgg.. I didn't expect them to loose control like that...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
呜...没想到它们会失控成这样...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
What is wrong with this whole thing?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
这到底是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Urr.. I think they will ruin my whole laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
呜...我觉得它们会毁掉我整个实验室！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! Wolfchev!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂！沃尔夫切夫！！

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You!? Hey, please stop them!
Creatures are ^9f6077organically connected with same job field^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
是你！？拜托，请阻止它们！
这些生物与^9f6077相同的职业领域^000000有着有机的联系。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
There is one special creature being their ^46B951boss position^000000...
If you could deactivate that creature, all ^A1BB44slave creatures^000000 walking around here will stop moving right away.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
其中有一个特殊的生物处于^46B951首领^000000的位置...
如果你能解除那个生物，这里游荡的所有^A1BB44宝箱巨鳄小兵^000000都会立刻停止行动。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boss creature?
Hey! Wolfchev! Where is that ^46B951Boss creature^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
首领生物？
喂！沃尔夫切夫！那个^46B951首领生物^000000在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Inside.. of laboratory.. It should be waken up now. It's sad to destroy my life of work, but I can't take this any more.. ...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
在...实验室里面...它现在应该已经苏醒了。虽然很遗憾要毁掉我毕生的心血，但我不能再这样下去了... ...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I get into the Wolfchev's laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该怎么进入沃尔夫切夫的实验室？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Oh.. Wait!
I will help you get in there.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
噢...等等！
我会帮你进去的。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Good news is that boss creatures are not set up to wake up all at once, even though slaves are.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
好消息是，首领生物不会像小兵那样同时全部苏醒。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
But still, it is really dangerous since we don't know when they will escape from there.
So, please prepare your party members, and take care of those boss creatures. I'm not sure how long this place can hold.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
但这依然非常危险，因为我们不知道它们什么时候会逃出来。
所以，请准备好你的队伍成员，并处理掉那些首领生物。我不确定这个地方还能撑多久。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Are you all set there? I will prepare the entrance if you are the leader of that party.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你们准备好了吗？如果你是那个队伍的首领，我就准备入口。

scripts.text: Any warnings?
scripts.translation: 有什么警告吗？

scripts.text: Going into the laboratory
scripts.translation: 进入实验室

scripts.text: Do not enter
scripts.translation: 不进入

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I didn't know pressing the emergency alarm would cause such problem. The management system seems to be changed to emergency mode.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我不知道按下紧急警报会导致这么大的问题。管理系统似乎已经切换到了紧急模式。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
There are so many systems set up inside of the laboratory, so eve I cannot be sure how systems are twisted by now.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
实验室里设置了这么多系统，我现在甚至无法确定系统现在处于什么状态。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah! If the emergency system is activating, only the leader of party should control everything. It is a lot of pressure I understand.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
啊！如果紧急系统正在激活，只有队伍的首领才能控制一切。我知道这压力很大。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
And just so you know, please do not touch random things out of curiosity. I don't want you to get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
顺便提醒一下，请不要出于好奇乱碰东西。我不想让你受伤。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I'm sorry, but it seems you still cannot enter to the laboratory yet. Will you come back later? The system is kind of tricky you know.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
很抱歉，看来你暂时还无法进入实验室。你稍后再来吗？系统现在有点不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You came back, Ka Ha Ha.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你回来了，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
After you left, I was fixing some system parts. And then suddenly strange thing happened.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你离开后，我正在修复一些系统部件。然后突然发生了奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
All those boss creatures you took care of started to regenerate themselves..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你之前处理掉的那些Boss怪物开始自我再生了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What.. How is that possible...?!

[Wolfchev]
I am also completely lost here.. But, this should not be happening..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我也完全搞不清楚状况...但是，这不应该发生...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
As you can see, you are the only one I can trust. Would you and your party help me once again deactivating those creatures?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你也看到了，你是唯一我能信任的人。你能和你的队伍再帮我一次，去关闭那些怪物吗？

scripts.text: I am not sure
scripts.translation: 我不确定

scripts.text: Why not
scripts.translation: 为什么不呢

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I see. I understand why you are hesitating, and don't want to press you any more. But, still I'm not sure why you want go there anyways,
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我明白了。我理解你犹豫的原因，也不想再强迫你。但是，我还是不明白你为什么还是想去那里。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Hmm.. Those boss creatures regenerating once again..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嗯...那些Boss怪物又开始再生了...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Can you help me just one more time?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你能再帮我一次吗？

scripts.text: I am not sure
scripts.translation: 我不确定

scripts.text: Why not
scripts.translation: 为什么不呢

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I see. I understand why you are hesitating, and don't want to press you any more. But, still I'm not sure why you want go there anyways,
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我明白了。我理解你犹豫的原因，也不想再强迫你。但是，我还是不明白你为什么还是想去那里。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Hmm.. Lab entering system is a bit weird. Would wait for me to check the system?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嗯...实验室进入系统有点奇怪。等我检查一下系统好吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Please hold on...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
请稍等...

scripts.text: Wolfchev starts to control certain gear.
scripts.translation: 沃尔夫切夫开始操作某些设备。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Alright! I have marked lan entering system code as
^0000ff{0}^000000 party leader's name ^0000ff{1}^000000!!.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
好了！我已经将实验室进入系统的代码标记为^0000ff{0}^000000队伍首领的名字^0000ff{1}^000000!!。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Now, your party is free to pass the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
好了，你的队伍可以自由通过入口了。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You are not the ^0000ffLeader of the party^000000, are you? Please go get the leader.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你并不是^0000ff队伍首领^000000，对吧？请去找首领。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Need more preparation? Please, we don't have all day.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
还需要更多准备吗？拜托了，我们可没那么多时间。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Are you trying to go there along? That is a suicide! Our lab entering system is not as easy as you thinkz`.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你想一个人去那里吗？那是自杀！我们的实验室进入系统没你想的那么简单。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Woot! Something weird just happen. If this keep happening, maybe we should try other way..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哇哦！刚才发生了奇怪的事。如果这种情况持续下去，也许我们应该试试别的方法...

scripts.translation: ^FF0000由于携带物品过多，您无法继续流程。^000000

scripts.translation: 您需要重新查看手册。

scripts.translation: 请让队伍首领来操作阀门。

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 请检查您的物品栏。您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You finally defeated my Boss creature.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你终于打败了我的首领生物。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Finally. is this the result?? For whom did I experiment? Did they cheat me?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
终于...这就是结果吗？我到底为谁做的实验？他们骗了我吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
The button was supposed to be pressed for an emergency case...but..
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
那个按钮本是为了紧急情况准备的...但是...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Hey... You and I met by a bad connection....
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嘿...你和我之间的相遇，真是一段糟糕的缘分...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
But...., you helped me... How could you do that?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
但是...你帮了我...你是怎么做到的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When I met you for the first time, you seemed mad but sad, even if you could commit those cruel and horrific experiments.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
初次见面时，你看起来既疯狂又悲伤，尽管你做了那些残酷可怕的实验。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But actually, you did that because you was lonely,.. you just concentrated on that for this reason, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但实际上，你这么做是因为孤独...你只是因为这个原因才如此专注，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
HAHAHAHA. Loneliness... you say?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哈哈哈哈哈。孤独...你是这么说的吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
It might be seen like that to you. But, it isn't. Loneliness is just a good and easy excuse of the losers.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
在你眼里可能就是这样。但事实并非如此。孤独只是失败者用来掩饰的廉价借口。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I'm so happy doing experiments pursuing for a perfection, I never feel lonely.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我在追求完美的实验中感到无比快乐，我从未感到过孤独。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Anyway, since I realized that Rekenber betrayed me, I cannot just let them do what they want.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
总之，既然我意识到雷肯贝特背叛了我，我就不能任由他们为所欲为。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
For now, I will leave them alone, but I will make them cry and regret for trying to remove Wolfchev.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
眼下，我会先放过他们，但我会让他们痛哭流涕，后悔当初试图除掉沃尔夫切夫。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
aaaaaah, {0} Thank you so much to remove my boys who had gone mad. Not a big gift but I wish you don't deny, I don't need this anymore.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
啊哈哈，{0}。非常感谢你帮我清理了那些发疯的家伙。虽然不是什么贵重的礼物，但希望你能收下，我不再需要它了。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
And, if you can...hope you to come back often, especially with your friends. I want the place to be with human heart again so the sadness in here gets disappear.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
还有，如果你愿意...希望你能常来，特别是带上你的朋友。我希望这里能重新充满人情味，让这里的悲伤消散。

scripts.text: I looked at Wolfchev again before leaving his lab. and I could feel that he was not obsessed anymore..
scripts.translation: 离开实验室前，我再次看了一眼沃尔夫切夫。我能感觉到，他不再那么偏执了...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
You did defeat all of the Boss creatures. Thank you again.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你打败了所有首领生物。再次感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I say again, {0} Thank you so much to remove my boys who had gone mad. Not a big gift but I wish you don't deny, I don't need this anymore.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
再说一次，{0}。非常感谢你帮我清理了那些发疯的家伙。虽然不是什么贵重的礼物，但希望你能收下，我不再需要它了。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Khahaha, See you again. Do you want to get out of here now?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
嘎哈哈，再见。你想现在离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 还没

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Then tell me when you want to.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
那你告诉我你想什么时候走。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Then I will send you out.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
那我送你出去。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I was looking at the system.... don't know who made this..... but it's so complicated to get..no idea...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我在看系统...不知道是谁做的...但这太复杂了...完全看不懂...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
kakakaah.. Thank you. You handled those Boss creatures well...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
哈哈...谢谢你。你处理那些Boss怪物的表现很不错...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
While you were struggling...
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
在你挣扎的时候...

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
I figured something out... and there's a system error which doesn't let us come and go freely, so you could help me in 72 hours... Go somewhere to rest before you come back.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
我想明白了一些事情...系统有个错误，导致我们无法自由进出。所以你能在72小时后回来帮我吗...回来之前先去休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Ah... and I can send you out of my laboratory. Do you want?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
啊...我可以把你送出我的实验室。你想出去吗？

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Do you want to get out of here now?
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
你现在想离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 还没

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Then tell me when you want to.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
那你告诉我你想什么时候走。

scripts.text:
[Wolfchev]
Then I will send you out.
scripts.translation:
[沃尔夫切夫]
那我送你出去。
